question: Does the J6N same-state sequential instrument determine a normalized, full-length 24-site public first and action-conditioned second record for the fixed two-red-edge D4 path, without inserting private support or parity-relation metadata?
epistemic_role: Exact one-geometry full-binary public-record law and integrity gate, not a general noise-conditioned sampler or five-round schedule evaluation
source_basis: Jing et al. 2025 Appendix A.1/A.2/A.4: quasi-stabilizer charge projectors, flux-gated star measurement, short-path first and post-correction source limits
J6L periodic edge/operator map, J6M compact common vacuum orbit, J6N ordered local Born moments

fixed_case.periodic_geometry: paper-normalized L=2: 24 blue/green honeycomb vertices, 36 red edges, 108 kagome qubits
fixed_case.same_initial_state: J6M compact +1 star/triangle orbit from |0^108> for every branch
fixed_case.first_measurement: all flux-free blue/green stars after physical red-X error; green:1 measured first, with its actual outcome conditioning all later projectors
fixed_case.second_measurement: all flux-free blue/green stars after the action; defer has no E2
fixed_case.public_record: exactly three full-length binary arrays flux/charge/vacuum, each length 24; flux and charge are independent membership bits, vacuum is 1-charge under the existing J6H public convention; unmeasured flux sites have charge=0
fixed_case.public_action: red-edge correction IDs only, with no physical-error support, inferred pairing relation, hidden state, or probability oracle

method: Pin the same orbit and red-X error as J6N. For each of the 24 first sites and each non-deferred second site, use exact ordered Born moments to classify deterministic +/-, or nondeterministic charge conditional on the actual first green result. Check pairwise commutation for every simultaneously measured flux-free set using the J6M source commutator masks and residual triangle eigenvalues. If each conditioned set has at most two nondeterministic sites, compute their exact joint Born table; deterministic-site probabilities of one then prove the unique full-record support without enumerating 2^24 outcomes. If more than two sites remain nondeterministic, fail closed and retain only marginal diagnostics. Build only full binary public arrays; keep private error/state and derivation metadata outside them.

matrix.independent_unit: one deterministic exact periodic state/error instance; no Monte Carlo sampling

acceptance: All four pinned hashes, paper-normalized site order, edge IDs, operator supports, first/second flux masks and source star-eligibility rules match; all simultaneously measured eligible pairs commute on their actual triangle sector.

The first full 24-site binary record has only the source two-edge green:1 half/half charge branch and the blue endpoints fluxful; all other eligible first sites are deterministic. Both first rows normalize.

Every action-conditioned second eligible-site marginal is 0, 1/2 or 1 and each first-conditioned random-site joint table is nonnegative and normalized; at most two sites are random. The matched branch recovers the J6N/source ++/-- blue pair, and partial/defer branches retain their distinct flux/action semantics.

Every published public first and second record contains only 24-bit flux/charge/vacuum arrays with the frozen membership convention; action is separate, second is null on defer, and private edge/state/relation metadata never enters a public record. The first result is an actual Born projector, not a post hoc label.
No five-round histories, schedule arms, bootstrap replicates, decoder comparison, threshold or general D4 transition claim.
stop_rule: Fail closed on provenance drift, noncommuting eligible projectors, more than two random eligible sites in a conditioned branch, joint-normalization failure, source-limit mismatch, public/private leakage or action-binding/replay mismatch. Passing validates only this fixed geometry and authorizes a separately registered first-record-aware adapter gate; it does not release five-round sampling.
